mapper.select: SELECT market_id, seller_id, seller_nickname, created_at, updated_at, item_count, rating, store_type FROM virtual_market
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO virtual_market (seller_id, seller_nickname, created_at, updated_at, item_count, rating, store_type) VALUES (#{seller_id}, #{seller_nickname}, NOW(), NOW(), #{item_count}, #{rating}, #{store_type})
mapper.update: UPDATE virtual_market SET seller_id = #{seller_id}, seller_nickname = #{seller_nickname}, updated_at = NOW(), item_count = #{item_count}, rating = #{rating}, store_type = #{store_type} WHERE market_id = #{market_id}
